newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Materials to take stake in Checkpoint unit.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Materials to take stake in Checkpoint unit.

text.p: Mitsubishi Materials Corp said on Wednesday that it would acquire a 20 percent stake in a wholly owned Japanese subsidiary of Checkpoint Systems Inc of the United States.
The share transaction will be made via a capital increase at the unit through a third-party allocation of new shares, Mitsubishi Materials said in a statement.
The unit sells Checkpoint Systems' radio frequency anti-theft systems in Japan.

Mitsubishi Materials has already tied up with Checkpoint Systems for joint development of a radio frequency identification system which it expects to be widely used for factories, transport systems and other applications.
